$comment: Recipe consumed by ~/.claude/skills/cut-release (references/bump-recipe.md). The TRACKED version is config.example.py's APP_VERSION; config.py is the gitignored local copy and may not exist on a fresh clone, so it is a todo rather than a files[] entry (the format has no optional file). APP_LAST_UPDATE bumps to the release date. Changelog body lives in data/changelog.yaml as a YAML list with HTML <li> bodies, so it is a todo.
todos: Set APP_LAST_UPDATE to "{TODAY}" in config.example.py (the old date is not known to the recipe, so it cannot be a literal pattern).
If the gitignored local config.py exists, set its APP_VERSION to "{NEW}" and APP_LAST_UPDATE to "{TODAY}" too — CLAUDE.md requires both files bumped, and post_check fails while they differ.
Prepend a new entry to data/changelog.yaml. Format: `- version: {NEW}` / ` date: {TODAY}` / ` tags:` / ` - type: ` / ` label:
Rebuild minified assets if any CSS/JS changed: `python3 build_css.py && python3 build_js.py`.
Smoke-test: launch the app and verify the new APP_VERSION shows in the footer / about page.
